neighbours.label: a material or process word modifying a part in a description of manufacturing or aerospace hardware (a metal cutting tool, a rotary hot foil unit, an aluminum ring), as opposed to the same material words on everyday objects
fire: The fixture clamps the casting against a carbide milling head on the machine bed.
Each nozzle is lined with a ceramic thermal coating before it is bolted to the engine.
Workers replaced the plastic mould with a steel forming die for the longer production run.
The booster is joined to the tank by an aluminum interstage adapter.
A laser welding station seals the titanium housing of each pump.
The line adds a rotary cold embossing unit behind the varnish tower.
The stamping press uses a hardened steel punch mounted on a hydraulic ram.
Technicians fitted a brass bearing sleeve to the turbine shaft before balancing it.
quiet: The photo sits on a wooden shelf next to a plant in the living room.
Each guest is given a ceramic coffee mug before they sit down at the table.
Grandma replaced the plastic spoon with a steel teaspoon for her morning tea.
The bracelet is joined to the watch by an aluminum clasp.
A wooden garden bench stands beside the titanium sculpture in the park.
The bakery adds a warm cinnamon glaze to the rolls on Sundays.
The kitchen drawer holds a steel bottle opener and a roll of string.
My cousin bought a brass door knocker for the house before moving in.

short: material or process modifier of a machine part
notes: Card: ' a' x8, ' an' x7, ' launch', ' metal', ' hot', ' hardware'. Output: this pole promotes parameter, ground, scaling, compliance. Probes: 'metal cutting tool' 0.60, 'rotary hot foil' 0.42, aluminum 0.27-0.37, 'tool steel' 0.34, 'diamond tipped' 0.31; everyday metal bracelet 0.08, metal hook 0.07, sugar glaze 0.05. The ' a'/' an' peaks at high activation stayed mostly under 0.35 in my probes.
